basic_info.description: Upgraded Home Move in ready - Explore a new angle on life at MIRA, luxury condominium homes developed by the team at Tishman Speyer and designed by award-winning architecture Studio Gang.  Located at the corner of Spear and Folsom Streets in San Francisco, CA, MIRA features iconic architecture, innovative layouts, striking views and a bold attitude.   Fresh and forward-thinking, MIRA invites you to shift your perspective on living in San Francisco.  All images are representative of the development.
